name: Hotel Fire Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
A fire broke out at the Grand Hotel at 2:15am. Three guests are suspects:
- Guest A (Robert): Room 302. Claims he was asleep since 11pm. Hotel keycard shows his door opened at 1:45am and 2:30am.
- Guest B (Linda): Room 415. Claims she was at the hotel bar until 1am, then went to her room. Bar receipt: 12:45am. Keycard: 1:05am room entry.
- Guest C (Michael): Room 208. Claims he was in the lobby using WiFi from 12am-3am. Lobby camera shows him from 12:10am-1:50am, then he disappears until 2:40am.
The fire started in the kitchen (near room 208) at 2:15am. The fire alarm was pulled manually at 2:18am. Extract each guest's timeline.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference against:
- Smoke detector logs: kitchen detector triggered at 2:14am, hallway detector at 2:16am
- Elevator logs: elevator used at 2:12am (goes near room 208)
- Stairwell access: stairwell door on floor 2 opened at 2:13am and 2:45am
- Fire alarm: manual pull station near room 208 activated at 2:18am
- Witness: night clerk saw someone in dark clothing near kitchen at 2:10am

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve with priority: electronic logs > camera footage > witness testimony > suspect statements. Physical evidence timestamps are authoritative.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Determine who set the fire and who pulled the alarm. Identify verified alibis and most likely arsonist.
